description: Replacement of existing dormer windows with new dormer windows in the front, rear and side roofslopes; alterations and increasing the height of the roof of first floor side extension including the installation of a new rooflight above; replacement of the existing single door with new double doors at second floor level to the rear elevation; refurbishment of the existing windows to the front and rear elevations.
subdivision_of_building: Amendments to the first ,second and roof.
